english_research_meaning: The October 6 2026 Windows study described a pinned 0.1.0 app-world baseline, exact Windows Git revision and static code/manifest/test method, not a live installation or current-main guarantee.
defeater_or_limit: Dated static source text is historical characterization, not a dynamic deployment observation.

english_research_meaning: The observed logical flow starts from external managed/standalone activation through AppContext, operations/scenarios catalogs, Qt coordinator, sequential runner, external core and local stores/projections.
defeater_or_limit: This code call-chain is one local Windows configuration, not proof of an installed shared application host or a generic remote transport.

english_research_meaning: The described desktop had six local navigation regions, a scenario-chat workroom, inspector and settings; background/assignment/presence/AI-looking models were mainly local scaffolds rather than executed remote capabilities.
defeater_or_limit: Visual affordances, control labels and static models do not establish active scheduler, real presence, remote identity or accepted product requirements.

english_research_meaning: Application operation and scenario types were mostly separated from Qt, but runtime bootstrap still created a Qt ScenarioCoordinator and some orchestration remained in desktop presentation.
defeater_or_limit: Some reusable semantics can be extracted, but Android or Web cannot be asserted to work by copying the current Qt-coupled bootstrap.

english_research_meaning: The source-level frozen Windows survey reported 198 tracked files, 149 Python files, 23 SVGs, 10 tests and a large single PNG; application and runtime code were nontrivial relative to UI.
defeater_or_limit: Physical counts, sizes and file-name proportions are dated to the pinned revision and not a general measure of product maturity or currently shipped functions.

english_research_meaning: The survey reported separate integration manifest, Python app/package, adapters, runtime, presentation, resource, engineering scripts and tests directories, plus some mistakenly tracked generated workspace state.
defeater_or_limit: Having named application directories is not proof of independent headless service boundaries, native release integrity or tested concurrency.

english_research_meaning: The old project assignment placed bank/macro collection/calculation/FileStore business methods in external stratbox and workspace/scenario/case/log/GUI semantics in stratbox-windows, with AppDock as external installation/session owner.
defeater_or_limit: This separation cannot grant external platform the authority for Strategy Box Work/Job/Artifact state; the current logical host is only a planned Product requirement.

english_research_meaning: The research noted Python >=3.10, external stratbox==0.2.1 dependency, PySide6 >=6.6 and the console script, distinguishing installation order from actual package availability.
defeater_or_limit: Stated packaging requirements are not proof of wheel installation, runtime environment correctness or forward-compatible Android support.

english_research_meaning: The pinned manifest declared world 0.1.0, desktop foreground/local Windows surface, default chat view, workspace view, presence/artifact flags, core package graph and diagnosis entrypoint; the adapter validated activation binding before launch.
defeater_or_limit: Manifest capability flags and declared views are not evidence of completed host scheduler, presence network or installed AppDock integration.

english_research_meaning: The desktop launcher supported GUI, diagnose/no-GUI and standalone development root; production startup required verified Activation Context and used a controlled startup error route.
defeater_or_limit: A --no-gui diagnostics path is not an application headless host, and a controlled exit-code contract is different from a successful native or AppDock launch.
